caption: The drawing features a single, cylindrical stoneware jar with a slightly flared rim and a flat base. The jar is light gray in color with subtle shading to indicate depth and roundness. On the front, there is a blue decorative motif that resembles a stylized plant or flower, with curling lines and leaf-like forms. Above the motif, there is a stamped or inscribed manufacturer’s mark in blue that reads "J. & E. Smith Co. / Manufacturers." The rim of the jar is depicted with a darker brownish shade, suggesting the interior. The drawing itself is centered within a rectangular border on a plain, light beige background. In the lower right corner, the name "N. Amantea" is signed in small letters.
title: Cookie Jar with Cover
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
